title: Slovakian Braised Tripe with Kissed Butter
description: A hearty and flavorful Slovakian-inspired dish featuring tender tripe slow-cooked in a rich broth with kissed butter and served with a side of stew.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of butter in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the tripe and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the tripe from the pot and set aside.
Add the remaining 2 tablespoons of kissed butter to the pot and stir to combine with the browned bits.
Add the Slovakian stew to the pot and bring to a boil.
Return the tripe to the pot and cover with a lid.
Transfer the pot to the oven and braise for 2 hours, or until the tripe is tender.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the tripe and sauce hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
